 "content": "---
name: continual-arc-3x3-marker-downsample
description: Use when an ARC grid has a 0/5 background and sparse marker colors in 3x3 blocks. Compress each block to its marker color or 0.
---

# Continual-ARC: 3×3 marker downsampling

## Trigger
A noisy ARC-style input is partitioned into non-overlapping 3×3 blocks; most cells are background (often 0 and 5), while other colors are sparse markers. The output dimensions are input dimensions divided by 3.

## Rule
For every 3×3 tile, emit the non-background marker color if present; otherwise emit 0. In this pattern 0 and 5 are background, and each tile contains at most one distinct marker color. The output has one cell per tile, preserving tile order and position.

## Procedure
1. Check that the input height and width are multiples of 3; output dimensions are H/3 × W/3.
2. Visit tiles in row-major order, with tile (i,j) covering rows 3i..3i+2 and columns 3j..3j+2.
3. Ignore 0 and 5 in each tile. If a remaining color exists, output it; if none exists, output 0.
4. Verify there are no tiles containing multiple distinct non-background colors, then submit the compressed grid.

## Evidence
A 27×27 demonstration maps to a 9×9 output, and a 21×21 test maps to 7×7 under this rule.",
